svg.desc: OS: Software Developer & Certified UAS Pilot; Host: Guayaquil, Ecuador; Uptime: 5 years, 6 months; Shell: bash; Job: Agricultural Drone Pilot @ Fumigasa; Fleet: DJI Agras T50 · T100 (DGAC Ecuador, 2025); Recent: Web & mail automation @ Mediacor Plus; Education: Culinary Arts · Escuela Culinaria de las Américas; Languages: Spanish · English · German (B2); Web: HTML · CSS/Sass · JS/TS · React · Vue · Angular; Backend: Node/Express · Laravel/PHP · Python · Java · Lua; DevOps: Linux · Docker · Jenkins · Nginx · GCP · Vault; Data: MySQL · MongoDB · WordPress · Apps Script · Bun; GitHub: 34 public repos · 847 contributions in the last year; Portfolio: aurelioochoa.github.io; LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/aurelioochoa. Logo credits: drone: original readmefetch art (MIT License); tux: ASCII art from fastfetch (MIT License, © 2021-2023 Linus Dierheimer, © 2022-2026 Carter Li), much of it originally from neofetch (MIT License, © 2015-2021 Dylan Araps); blinking eyes added by readmefetch; computer: ASCII art by aniwey from Candy Box 2 (CC BY-SA 3.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/); cropped to the monitor, coloured and given an animated screen by readmefetch; cauldron: ASCII art by dixsept from Candy Box 2 (CC BY-SA 3.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/); colours, bubbles and fire animation added by readmefetch; banner: FIGlet font slant: Slant by Glenn Chappell 3/93 -- based on Standard; FIGlet © 1991-1994 Glenn Chappell & Ian Chai, © 1996-2001 John Cowan, © 2002 Christiaan Keet, © 2011 Claudio Matsuoka (BSD-3-Clause); colours by readmefetch
